title: Native browser and screen-reader coverage
focus: Own actual native/AT evidence organization and screenshot review procedure. Execute feasible missing trusted browser flows in an isolated host; prepare a specific runnable screen-reader operator protocol. A-X11 is blocked unless actual spoken output/platform/operator observations are available; never fabricate or close it from DOM/axe. No auto-accepting screenshots.
